subject: Mythology
title: The Titans: First Gods of Greece
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Titans: First Gods of Greece.

hook.text: Before Zeus, the Titans ruled the universe. They were the original gods — enormous, powerful, and eventually overthrown.

buildup.text: Kronos led the Titans after castrating his own father Uranus with a sickle to seize power over the cosmos.

discovery.text: Paranoid about prophecy, Kronos swallowed each of his children at birth. Zeus survived because his mother hid him.

twist.text: Zeus freed his siblings from Kronos's stomach and led a ten-year war that ended with the Titans imprisoned in Tartarus.

climax.text: Prometheus, a Titan who sided with Zeus, stole fire for humans and was chained to a rock as punishment forever.

punchline.text: The gods before the gods taught Zeus everything, including how to fall.

quiz.question: Why did Kronos swallow his own children?
options: He wanted to absorb their powers
A prophecy said one of his children would overthrow him
He was tricked by the other Titans into doing it
